3132-in-the-wilderness.title: In The Wilderness
3132-in-the-wilderness.creator: Charles Dudley Warner
3132-in-the-wilderness.description: A book by Charles Dudley Warner. It adds to the manly aspect of a person with a tin pail if he also carries a gun. It was possible I might start up a partridge; though how I was to hit him, if he started up instead of standing still, puzzled me. Many people use a shotgun for partridges.

arxiv-1701-05943.title: Structure of optimal strategies for remote estimation over Gilbert-Elliott channel with feedback
arxiv-1701-05943.creator: Jhelum Chakravorty, Aditya Mahajan
arxiv-1701-05943.description: Abstract We investigate remote estimation over a Gilbert-Elliot channel with feedback. We assume that the channel state is observed by the receiver and fed back to the transmitter with one unit delay. In addition, the transmitter gets ack / nack feedback for successful/unsuccessful transmission.

arxiv-1810-12366.title: Do Explanations make VQA Models more Predictable to a Human?
arxiv-1810-12366.creator: Arjun Chandrasekaran, Viraj Prabhu, Deshraj Yadav, Prithvijit Chattopadhyay, Devi Parikh
arxiv-1810-12366.description: Abstract A rich line of research attempts to make deep neural networks more transparent by generating human-interpretable ‘explanations’ of their decision process, especially for interactive tasks like Visual Question Answering (VQA). In this work, we analyze if existing explanations indeed make a VQA model – its responses as well as failures – more predictable to a human.

arxiv-2012-05901.title: Robust Consistent Video Depth Estimation
arxiv-2012-05901.creator: Johannes Kopf Facebook, Xuejian Rong Facebook, Jia-Bin Huang Virginia Tech
arxiv-2012-05901.description: Abstract We present an algorithm for estimating consistent dense depth maps and camera poses from a monocular video. We integrate a learning-based depth prior, in the form of a convolutional neural network trained for single-image depth estimation, with geometric optimization, to estimate a smooth camera trajectory as well as detailed and stable depth reconstruction.

arxiv-2201-09183.title: Transmission Electron Microscopy at the Quantum Limit
arxiv-2201-09183.creator: Stewart A. Koppell, Yonatan Israel, Adam J. Bowman, Brannon B. Klopfer, Mark A. Kasevich
arxiv-2201-09183.description: Abstract A number of visions for a new generation of dose-efficient electron microscopes have been advanced. These proposals, while inspired by quantum principles, make little contact with the broader field of quantum metrology. We discuss a framework calculating the amount of information carried by each electron.

arxiv-2205-05723.title: Ultra-wide Bandwidth Observations of 19 pulsars with Parkes telescope
arxiv-2205-05723.creator: Zu-Rong Zhou, Jing-Bo Wang, Na Wang, George Hobbs, Shuang-Qiang Wang
arxiv-2205-05723.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zu-Rong Zhou, Jing-Bo Wang, Na Wang, George Hobbs, Shuang-Qiang Wang. Flux densities are basic observation parameters to describe pulsars. In the most updated pulsar catalog, 24 % \% of the listed radio pulsars have no flux density measurement at any frequency. Here, we report the first flux density measurements, spectral indices, pulse profiles, and correlations of the spectral index with pulsar parameters for 19 pulsars employing the Ultra-Wideband Low (UWL) receiver system installed on the Parkes radio telescope.

arxiv-2403-09716.title: Introductory notes on real-enriched categories Thanks: The author gratefully acknowledges the support of the National Natural Science Foundation of China (No. 12371463).
arxiv-2403-09716.creator: Dexue Zhang
arxiv-2403-09716.description: Abstract . Real-enriched categories are categories with real numbers as enrichment. Precisely, a real-enriched category is a category enriched over the commutative and unital quantale composed of the unit interval and a continuous t-norm. These notes present a brief introduction to such categories, focusing on the presheaf monad and its submonads in the category of real-enriched categories.

arxiv-2505-23070.title: Bayesian Inference for Non-Gaussian Simultaneous Autoregressive Models with Missing Data
arxiv-2505-23070.creator: Anjana Wijayawardhana, David Gunawan, Thomas Suesse
arxiv-2505-23070.description: Abstract Standard simultaneous autoregressive (SAR) models typically assume normally distributed errors, an assumption often violated in real-world datasets that frequently exhibit non-normal, skewed, or heavy-tailed characteristics. New SAR models are proposed to capture these non-Gaussian features. The spatial error model (SEM), a widely used SAR-type model, is considered. Three novel SEMs are introduced, extending the standard Gaussian SEM.

arxiv-2512-11996.title: Isolated Points on Modular Curves of Prime-Power Level
arxiv-2512-11996.creator: Chris Calger
arxiv-2512-11996.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chris Calger. An isolated point on an algebraic curve is a closed point not belonging to a collection of points of the same degree parametrized by 𝐏 1 \mathbf{P}^{1} or a positive rank abelian subvariety of the curve’s Jacobian. We study the sets of j j -invariants, in extensions of bounded degree, that arise as the j j -invariant of an isolated point on a modular curve. We obtain finiteness results on these sets for families of modular curves with prime-power level.

arxiv-2605-00197.creator: Aurélien Bück-Kaeffer 1,2,4 Sneheel Sarangi 1,2 Maximilian Puelma Touzel 1,3 Reihaneh Rabbany 1,2 Zachary Yang 1,2,4 Jean-François Godbout 2,3 1 McGill University, 2 Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, 3 Université de Montréal, 4 Ubisoft La Forge

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-edmund-bolton.description: Article 'Edmund Bolton' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

europmc-pmc4448150.title: Actin depletion initiates events leading to granule secretion at the immunological synapse.
europmc-pmc4448150.creator: Ritter AT, Asano Y, Stinchcombe JC, Dieckmann NM, Chen BC, Gawden-Bone C, van Engelenburg S, Legant W, Gao L, Davidson MW, Betzig E, Lippincott-Schwartz J, Griffiths GM.
europmc-pmc4448150.description: Cytotoxic T lymphocytes (CTLs) use polarized secretion to rapidly destroy virally infected and tumor cells. To understand the temporal relationships between key events leading to secretion, we used high-resolution 4D imaging. CTLs approached targets with actin-rich projections...

plos-pone-0006660.title: Integrating Functional and Diffusion Magnetic Resonance Imaging for Analysis of Structure-Function Relationship in the Human Language Network
plos-pone-0006660.creator: Victoria L. Morgan, Arabinda Mishra, Allen T. Newton et al.
plos-pone-0006660.description: PLOS ONE research article. The capabilities of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to measure structural and functional connectivity in the human brain have motivated growing interest in characterizing the relationship between these measures in the distributed neural networks of the brain. In this study, we a

pmc-10587538.title: Controlling Salmonella: strategies for feed, the farm, and the processing plant
pmc-10587538.creator: Tomi Obe, Timothy Boltz, Mike Kogut, Steven C Ricke, Lasheda A Brooks, Ken Macklin, Ashley Peterson
pmc-10587538.description: Controlling Salmonella in poultry is an ongoing food safety measure and while significant progress has been made, there is a need to continue to evaluate different strategies that include understanding Salmonella-poultry interaction, Salmonella-microbiota interactions, Salmonella genetics and response to adverse conditions, and preharvest and postharvest parameters that enable persistence.

pmc-11401138.title: Comparative study of echocardiographic parameters in healthy and dilated cardiomyopathy-affected dogs
pmc-11401138.creator: Pritish Rath, Biswadeep Jena, Sidhartha Sankar Behera, Srinivas Sathapathy, Prasana Kumar Rath, Swetapadma Sarangi
pmc-11401138.description: Echocardiography is a non-invasive and gold standard imaging tool for diagnosing dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) in dogs. This study aimed to compare the echocardiographic parameters between healthy and DCM-affected dogs. A total of 52 client-owned dogs, comprising 38 males and 14 females, were included. Among these, 24 dogs (46.15%) were classified as healthy controls and 28 dogs (53.

pmc-11436617.title: Medical Toxicology vs. Emergency Medicine and Internal Medicine — Are We Really Full of Case Reports?
pmc-11436617.creator: Jason B Hack, Kevin F O’Brien
pmc-11436617.description: IntroductionCase reports are perceived as having diminished value relative to other study designs. It has been said that medical toxicology (MT) is based largely upon case report literature and thought to be unique in this regard. We sought to quantify recent MT publication of case reports compared with top periodicals from emergency medicine (EM) and internal medicine (IM) journals.

pmc-11641301.title: Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms on Toll-like Receptor-4 and the Risk of Developing Skin Cancer
pmc-11641301.creator: Nabiha Yusuf, Noha Sharafeldin, Mohammad Saleem, Tom Callens, Ludwine M Messiaen, Craig A Elmets, Silvia Cantara
pmc-11641301.description: Exposure to solar ultraviolet (UV) radiation is an established risk factor for skin cancer. Toll-like receptor-4 (TLR4)-mediated immune dysregulation has emerged as a key mechanism for the detrimental effects of acute and chronic UV exposure and skin cancer in mice.

pmc-12560315.title: Bridging the evidence gap: research equity in conflict-affected health systems
pmc-12560315.creator: Nidal Derar Muna
pmc-12560315.description: Despite bearing a disproportionate share of the global disease burden, low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) contribute minimally to clinical trial data. Using the Palestinian Territories as a case study, this commentary explores how structural barriers in conflict-affected health systems create gaps in clinical evidence.

pmc-12577845.title: Spontaneous rupture of pseudoaneurysm of testicular artery: a case report on an unusual presentation in dengue hemorrhagic syndrome
pmc-12577845.creator: Suraj KC, Tek Nath Yogi, Shailesh Maharjan, Ashish Sapkota, Awaj Kafle, Rikesh Jung Karkee
pmc-12577845.description: Background:Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) is a mosquito-borne viral illness that can lead to severe bleeding complications. However, its association with the rupture of a testicular artery pseudoaneurysm due to orchitis is extremely rare. Testicular pseudoaneurysms are usually linked to trauma, infection, or inflammation.

pmc-12591900.title: Anatomic features of congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction: a comparative computed tomography study
pmc-12591900.creator: Wushuang Wang, Yue Tan, Tong Lin, Lan Gong
pmc-12591900.description: BackgroundInvestigating the anatomic features of congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction (CNLDO) is crucial for understanding its etiology and guiding surgical management. This study aimed to compare the computed tomography (CT)-based features of the lacrimal sac fossa (LF) and nasolacrimal duct (NLD) in CNLDO patients against matched controls.

pmc-12775625.title: Gigantic lumbar aneurysmal bone cyst with abdominal extension in a pediatric patient: case report and its multidisciplinary management
pmc-12775625.creator: Anouar Bourghli, Faisal Konbaz, Firas Alsebayel, Monerah Annaim, Ziad Alyousif, Jehan Howsawi, Zakaria Habib, Khalid AlMusrea
pmc-12775625.description: BackgroundAneurysmal bone cyst (ABC) is a rare, benign, and highly vascular osteolytic lesion characterized by expansile cystic spaces filled with blood and surrounded by thinned cortical bone. ABC is most commonly found in the vertebral column, most specifically in the posterior element of the lumbar spine.

pmc-12937531.title: Comparative analysis of revision causes between robotic-assisted and conventional manual unicompartmental knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12937531.creator: Pengyu Xiang, Hongfu Jin, Yiming Dai, Yixin Yang, Chenhao Jia, Lather Sagar, Jian Zhang, Yungang Wu, Chunwu Zhang, Shengwu Yang, Zhenhan Deng
pmc-12937531.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundRobotic-assisted unicompartmental knee arthroplasty (R-UKA) is an emerging procedure; however, its benefits over conventional manual unicompartmental knee arthroplasty (C-UKA) are controversial, especially the revision and failure rates, and existing studies failed to reach a consensus on this issue.MethodsThe literature search was conducted on four databases (PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library and Web of Science) from inception to 28 April 2025 according to the guidelines for Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analysis (PRISMA).

pmc-13158506.title: Entropy as a Tool for Quantifying Biomedical Signals: Gaps and Opportunities in Clinical Methodological Approaches—A Scoping Review
pmc-13158506.creator: Luis Gabriel Gómez Acosta, Max Chacón Pacheco
pmc-13158506.description: In biomedical and engineering research, entropy metrics have become well-established tools for assessing the complexity of dynamic and physiological systems. This scoping review examines the relationship between information theory quantifiers (ITQs), bioelectrical signals, and time series, and the limited diagnostic value of these measures in functional dyspepsia (FD).

pmc-13218590.title: Phenotyping and clinical utility of phagocytic polyploid giant cancer macrophages in blood
pmc-13218590.creator: Daniel L Adams, Massimo Cristofanilli, Steven H Lin, Raymond C Bergan, Thai H Ho, Jeffrey R Marks, Stuart S Martin, Martin J Edelman, Saranya Chumsri, Elizabeth J Hager, Cha-Mei Tang, Susan Tsai, R Katherine Alpaugh
pmc-13218590.description: Historically, polyploid giant cancer cells (PGCCs) within tumors have been ignored as superfluous inflammatory refuse with no intrinsic clinical or biological relevance. However recently, multiple studies have described the existence PGCCs in solid tumor masses that appear to correlate with tumor progression, and can also appear in blood circulation as cancer associated macrophage like cells (CAMLs).

pmc-13261873.title: Isotopic Fractionation and Masking Effects during Biotransformation of Chlorinated Ethanes
pmc-13261873.creator: Elizabeth Phillips, Joan De Vera, Steffen Kümmel, Olivia Bulka, Weibin Chen, Elizabeth Edwards, Ivonne Nijenhuis, Matthias Gehre, Barbara Sherwood Lollar
pmc-13261873.description: Chlorinated ethanes, such as 1,1,1-trichloroethane (1,1,1-TCA) and 1,1-dichloroethane (1,1-DCA), are common groundwater contaminants that undergo abiotic and biotic transformation, although the specific mechanisms remain unresolved. Compound-specific isotope analysis (CSIA) can provide insight into transformation mechanisms, but its application to chlorinated ethanes has been limited compared to the extensive literature on chlorinated ethenes.

pmc-13262999.title: Physical Fitness and Physical Activity Levels One Year after Total Hip Arthroplasty in Older Hip Osteoarthritis Patients: A Longitudinal Observational Study
pmc-13262999.creator: Manne Godhe, Anders Stålman, Johnny Nilsson, Eva Andersson
pmc-13262999.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionTotal hip arthroplasty (THA) effectively alleviates pain and improves quality of life in patients with severe hip osteoarthritis (OA). However, there are limited comprehensive longitudinal data on physical function and objectively measured physical activity (PA) patterns after THA.

pmc-13298860.title: Impact of Warm-Air Withering Methods on Aroma Quality of White Teas from Four Tea Cultivars
pmc-13298860.creator: Fan Huang, Yingbo Huang, Xuejiao Gong, Bowen Chen, Juan Zhang, Qian Guo, Wenyi Zhang, Yulong Ye, Zeqiang Ma, Yingchun Wang

pmc-13602416.title: Evaluating sonographic response and remission in inflammatory bowel disease: aligning intestinal ultrasound assessment with STRIDE-II timelines
pmc-13602416.creator: Ashish R Srinivasan, Shintaro Sagami, Andrew Nguyen, Rebecca L Smith, Abhinav Vasudevan, Stuart A Taylor
pmc-13602416.description: Background and AimsThe diagnostic accuracy of intestinal ultrasound (IUS) is established; however, guidance on the timing and interpretation of sonographic response and remission in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) remains limited. This review synthesizes current evidence to define expected response and remission kinetics in Crohn’s disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC) across STRIDE-II aligned reassessment timepoints.

pmc-13651089.title: The impact of timely community health services contact following hospital discharge on subsequent hospital use in England: retrospective observational study
pmc-13651089.creator: Beth Parkinson, Matt Sutton, Lachlan Cameron, Rachel Meacock
pmc-13651089.description: BackgroundUnplanned rehospitalisation is an undesirable outcome for patients and resource-constrained health systems. Community health services (CHS) support safe transitions home and recovery following hospital discharge, but evidence on their effectiveness in reducing rehospitalisation is limited. This study examined the impact of timely contact with CHS teams following hospital discharge on the odds of subsequent emergency hospital care.
